answer: An operator running 257 keys hence pays for 257 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the wharf quota and the grove admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the ivory ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 4 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
